name: Misfit Agent Evaluation Lab External Evaluator Kit
purpose: Reduce friction for an independent evaluator to run a public benchmark against the bounded Agent Evaluation Lab surface and return reproducible evidence without receiving protected GHOSBC internals.

supported_external_profiles.note: Evaluator must pin the exact benchmark/harness version or commit in the evidence receipt.
Evaluator must supply a stable public benchmark reference plus exact version or commit; Misfit does not claim an official repository here.
Evaluator must supply a stable public benchmark reference plus exact version or commit; Misfit does not claim an official repository here.

evaluation_sequence: 1. Pin benchmark/harness version or commit and evaluator identity.
2. Read the A2A Agent Card or OpenAPI contract and target only the bounded public evaluation surface.
3. Run the external benchmark independently; do not request or infer private GHOSBC kernel material.
4. Preserve benchmark-native raw outputs and environment/version metadata.
5. Produce an evidence receipt conforming to the published external benchmark evidence schema.
6. Set externally_validated=true only when an independent evaluator actually ran the benchmark and the referenced artifact supports the statement.
7. Return stable artifact/result references and SHA-256 when available.

commercial_boundary.note: This kit is a public evaluator handoff, not a paid third-party validation service.

prohibited: private GHOSBC kernel source or prompts
Mother Language / Soul Cipher / GHX / glyph internals
